shortDescription: MACsec Policy configuration for Cisco Intersight

options.name: api_bearer_token
options.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication with the Intersight API. When provided, I(api_key_id) and I(api_private_key) are not required and the C(cryptography) Python library is not needed. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable is used.

options.name: api_key_id
options.description: Public API Key ID associated with the private key. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_KEY_ID environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_private_key
options.description: Filename (absolute path) or string of PEM formatted private key data to be used for Intersight API authentication. If a string is used, Ansible vault should be used to encrypt string data. Ex. ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id tme@/Users/dsoper/Documents/vault_password_file '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----     <your private key data>     -----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----' If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not

options.name: api_uri
options.description: URI used to access the Intersight API. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_URI environment variable is used.

options.name: cipher_suite
options.description: Cipher suite to be used for MACsec encryption.

options.name: confidentiality_offset
options.description: The MACsec confidentiality offset specifies the number of bytes starting from the frame header. MACsec encrypts only the bytes after the offset in a frame.

options.name: configure_fallback_keychain
options.description: Enable configuration of fallback keychain.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description for the MACsec Policy. Description can contain letters(a-z, A-Z), numbers(0-9), hyphen(-), period(.), colon(:), or an underscore(_).

options.name: eapol_ethertype
options.description: Ethertype to use in EAPoL frames for MKA PDUs. The range is between 0x600 - 0xffff.

options.name: eapol_mac_address
options.description: MAC address to use in extensible authentication protocol over LAN (EAPoL) for MKA PDUs. EAPol MAC address should not be equal to all-zero (0000.0000.0000).

options.name: fallback_keychain_name
options.description: Fallback keychain name. Required when C(configure_fallback_keychain) is C(true).

options.name: fallback_keys
options.description: List of security keys for the fallback keychain.

options.name: include_icv_indicator
options.description: Configures inclusion of the optional integrity check value (ICV) indicator. Part of the transmitted MACsec key agreement protocol data unit (PDU).

options.name: key_server_priority
options.description: Key server is selected by comparing priority values during MKA message exchange. Valid values range from 0 to 255. Lower value means higher chance of being selected as key server.

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the MACsec Policy. The name must be between 1 and 64 alphanumeric characters, allowing special characters :-_.

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the Organization this resource is assigned to. Profiles, Policies, and Pools that are created within a Custom Organization are applicable only to devices in the same Organization.

options.name: primary_keychain_name
options.description: Primary keychain name for managing the default set of security keys.

options.name: primary_keys
options.description: List of security keys for the primary keychain.

options.name: replay_window_size
options.description: Defines the size of the replay protection window. Determines the number of packets that can be received out of order without being considered replay attacks. Valid range is from 0 to 596000000.

options.name: sak_expiry_time
options.description: Time in seconds to force secure association key (SAK) rekey. Valid range is from 60 to 2592000 seconds. When set to 0 or not configured, SAK rekey interval is determined based on interface speed.

options.name: security_policy
options.description: The security policy specifies the level of MACsec enforcement on network traffic. C(should-secure) allows unencrypted traffic until MKA session is secured. C(must-secure) only allows MACsec encrypted traffic.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify the resource is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify the resource is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags in Key:<user-defined key> Value:<user-defined value> format.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean control for verifying the api_uri TLS certificate
